segments.name: Microturbine energy systems
segments.description: Designs, manufactures, sells and rents microturbine power generation systems, with related parts and services, for industrial and commercial customers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single reportable segment encompassing the development, manufacture, sale, and rental of microturbine energy systems and their related parts and services.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for microturbine systems, parts, services, rentals, and energy-as-a-service agreements such as power purchase, leasing, and long-term service contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: To support evolving customer needs, Capstone also offers flexible Energy as a Service ("EaaS") solutions, including power purchase or energy service agreements (PPAs/ESAs), leasing, rentals, and long-term service agreements designed to reduce upfront costs, accelerate deployment, and provide life-cycle cost predictability.
